XMLDB.COMMENT: Interactive video: a timeline of questions over a video, and what each learner answered.

FIELD.NAME: videourl
FIELD.COMMENT: A file the browser can play directly. Deliberately not an embed code: what plays has to be something we can hand to a <video> element, because that is what makes the proctoring adapter work unchanged.

FIELD.NAME: mustanswer
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the video refuses to continue past an unanswered question.

FIELD.NAME: allowreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a learner may answer a question again after seeing the outcome.

FIELD.NAME: completionanswerall
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion requires every question on the timeline to have been answered.

FIELD.NAME: completionwatched
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion requires reaching the end of the video.

FIELD.NAME: attime
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds into the video. Stored with decimals because a question landing mid-word is worse than one landing a moment late.

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: What this question is about, free text chosen by the author. On the item rather than the activity because one video usually covers several topics, and a report that cannot separate them cannot say which topic a cohort is weak on. Empty means uncategorised, which is a legitimate answer and not a missing value.

FIELD.NAME: choices
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of option texts in the order shown. Empty for shorttext and info.

FIELD.NAME: answers
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON. Option indexes for the choice types, accepted strings for shorttext, empty for info. Never sent to the browser before the learner answers.

TABLE.NAME: kaivideo_response
TABLE.COMMENT: What one learner answered, every time they answered it.

FIELD.NAME: response
FIELD.COMMENT: What the learner sent: JSON option indexes, or their typed text. Kept verbatim so a teacher can see what was actually said, not only whether it was accepted.

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: The item's category as it stood when this was answered. Copied rather than read back through the item on purpose: recategorising a question next term must not silently rewrite what last term's report said about a cohort.

TABLE.NAME: kaivideo_progress
TABLE.COMMENT: How far one learner has got. Every attempt is kept in kaivideo_response; this is the summary the activity reads.

FIELD.NAME: furthest
FIELD.COMMENT: Furthest point reached, in seconds. Never rewound by watching again.
